the time course of processing of distinct facial regions and the associate ERP components.
the automatic processing of faces and with the neural mechanisms underlying face processing.
the automatic processing of the eyes, which are very salient features of faces and which are important for the social communication of humans.

the eyes are the most salient feature of the face, which is processed very fast and automatically.

the eyes are processed very early and very fast and are very salient features of the face.
